_source: Live aseqdump on this unit, port resolved by name. Press and release checked through F7. Checksum matches DeviceValue::ValidateMidiMessage.
_format: Button state param is 0x01020100 + id, value 1 press / 0 release, sent as F0 00 01 05 42 00 01 <id> 01 02 01 <state> 00 00 00 <cs> F7. A momentary bitmask on param 0x00020000 follows; ignore it. The press field is the prefix the listener matches.
